en.name: Codex
en.description: Codex in Textus AI: it reads your folder, writes and edits your notes, and asks before it changes anything.
en.setup: Needs Node.js. The first time, a browser opens to sign in with ChatGPT; or once in a terminal: npx -y @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp@2.6.0 cli login
